subject: Decision reports and the rest of Pro
preheader: PDF export, 10-year projections, Offer Ceiling, and deal compare.
headline: You're underwriting deals — here's what Pro adds when one gets serious.
body: You've been running deals on TrueCap — nice. When a deal gets real, Pro is what turns the analysis into something you can act on and share.

It adds PDF decision reports, 10-year cash-flow and equity projections, the sensitivity grid and Offer Ceiling solver, editing and unlimited saved deals with side-by-side comparison — plus Buy Box rule-fit checks using your criteria. The Offer Ceiling is a modeled boundary, not a recommended offer; verify every material assumption before acting.

Free saves up to 5 deals. New accounts receive a 21-day, no-card free trial for three complete Pro deals and one full comparison. A subscription starts only from an explicit checkout and charges the amount shown before confirmation; review current pricing and cancellation terms before upgrading.
